summary:
Frontend-only test of PDF split-crash fix and new unsaved-changes leave guard on Expo web preview (390x844 for phone flows, 820x1180 for tablet Notes flow). PASSED: (A) PDF-BUG-FIX — Seeded project with 1 sketch + 1 checklist (0 items checked) which forces the auto-regenerate PDF useEffect at projects/[id].tsx:467 to run generatePdfHtml() through the empty-checklist branch. Console shows NO 'Error auto-regenerating PDF', NO 'Cannot read property split of undefined', NO 'Error generating preview'. The fix at ~line 1619-1629 (returning a proper object with categoriesHtml='

Keine Positionen abgehakt

' instead of a string) is correct and covers the split() call at line 1718. (B) LEAVE-GUARD customers/new — Type Nachname 'TestLast' + click header back arrow → window.confirm 'Seite verlassen? Ihre Änderungen werden gespeichert.' fires; accept → customer saved with lastName='TestLast', KD-26001 assigned; navigated back to customers list. Dismiss path also verified (stays on form, aufmassprofi_customers stays empty). (C) LEAVE-GUARD customers/[id] edit — Change lastName to 'MusterEDITED' + header back → confirm fires; accept → customer.lastName='MusterEDITED' persisted, updated_at bumped. (D) LEAVE-GUARD projects/[id] outer 'Zurück' from Notes state — After typing remarks in the Notizen tab, switching back to Info tab, then clicking the OUTER 'Zurück' back arrow, the confirm dialog fires and remarks 'TEST_Bemerkung_XYZ' are correctly persisted to project.remarks. PARTIAL / DEVIATION FROM SPEC: LEAVE-GUARD projects/[id] Notizen — When the user is directly on the Notes tab and clicks the header 'Projektdetails' back arrow, NO confirm dialog appears and no save happens; the click merely switches the internal activeTab back to 'overview' via handleTabChange('overview') (see projects/[id].tsx:402-417). Root cause: on non-overview tabs the header back button is wired to a tab-state change, not to router.back(), so usePreventRemove never sees a route-removal action. The review specifically expected the confirm to fire on that 'Projektdetails' arrow. The unsaved remarks state IS preserved across the tab switch and IS ultimately saved when the user actually leaves the route (outer Zurück / swipe-back), so no data loss — but the UX deviates from the described behavior on web. On native the same pattern will apply because the header handler is Platform-independent. NOT TESTED IN THIS ITERATION: LEAVE-GUARD reports/edit (Rapport tab is gated behind Pro/expert mode; identical hook usage was already validated on customers/new + customers/[id] + notes-flow so risk is low). LEAVE-GUARD projects/new browser-back (called out as a known web limitation in the review). Regression checks (status pipeline filter tabs, sketch editor, expert PROFI2024) were validated in detail in iteration_24 and are unaffected by this iteration's edits. CONSOLE NOISE (unchanged from iter 23/24): repeated 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a .', deprecated 'shadow*' style props, deprecated 'props.pointerEvents'.

ui_bugs.component: projects/[id].tsx header back button on non-overview tabs
ui_bugs.issue: When the user is on the Notizen / Photos / Sketches / Checklists / etc. tab and taps the header 'Projektdetails' back arrow, the handler only calls handleTabChange('overview'). It never triggers router.back(), so the useUnsavedChangesGuard hook (which uses usePreventRemove) does NOT intercept and no save-confirm dialog appears. The review explicitly expected a confirm on that arrow when leaving Notizen with unsaved Bemerkungen. Unsaved data is not lost (state is preserved across the tab switch and saved on the eventual outer Zurück), but the UX diverges from spec. Reference: /app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx:402-417.

integration_issues.issue: Guard does not fire because the header back on non-overview tabs is a tab-state change, not a route pop. Consider wiring the Projektdetails back button to also trigger a save prompt when remarksChanged (or any per-tab dirty flag) is true — e.g. call the guard's save callback directly before handleTabChange, or convert this to a router.back() when applicable.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated: 'shadow*' style props — should migrate to boxShadow (many screens).
Deprecated: props.pointerEvents — should migrate to style.pointerEvents (sketches/draw.tsx ~7208).

Repeated console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' fires on home, project detail and other screens. Non-fatal but should be traced (a literal '.' or `{' '}` between elements inside a <View>).

action_items: MEDIUM: Wire the Projektdetails header back button on non-overview tabs (projects/[id].tsx:402-417) to also honor the unsaved-changes guard. Simplest fix: before calling handleTabChange('overview'), check remarksChanged (or any tab-local dirty flag) and, on web, run window.confirm('Seite verlassen? Ihre Änderungen werden gespeichert.') → save via the same handler as the leaveGuard onSaveAndLeave; on native use Alert.alert. Alternatively, keep the tab-switch behavior but always silently persist remarks when leaving the Notizen tab.
LOW: Trace and fix the stray '.'/whitespace text node causing 'Unexpected text node' warnings across screens (index.tsx, projects/[id].tsx, likely others).
LOW: Continue react-native-web shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents migration.

NEXT AGENT: If needed, retest LEAVE-GUARD on reports/edit after unlocking expert mode with PROFI2024 (Settings → Erweitert → PROFI2024) — the underlying hook is the same and confirmed working, so risk is low.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx:1619-1629 — Empty-checklist branch now correctly returns { categoriesHtml, totalChecked, totalItems, templateLogoHtml } so the downstream .split('<!--CATEGORY_SPLIT-->') at line 1718 works. Verified no runtime error under the empty-checklist + auto-regenerate condition. Good fix.

/app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx:402-417 — Header back button on non-overview tabs bypasses the leave guard because it does not trigger a route removal. Consider integrating with useUnsavedChangesGuard.

/app/frontend/src/hooks/useUnsavedChangesGuard.ts — Clean implementation. Web branch correctly uses window.confirm (works on RN-web where Alert.alert multi-button falls back to window.alert). autoSave option not exercised in this iteration.
/app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx is 10,301 lines — should be split into subcomponents for maintainability (unchanged concern from iter 23).

success_rate.frontend: PDF fix 1/1 PASS; leave-guard 3/4 flows PASS (customers/new, customers/[id], projects Notes via outer Zurück). 1 flow deviates from spec: Projektdetails inner back on Notes tab does not fire guard.

seed_data_creation: Injected localStorage keys aufmassprofi_settings (disclaimer accepted), aufmassprofi_customers, aufmassprofi_projects, aufmassprofi_sketches, aufmassprofi_checklists, aufmassprofi_checklist_templates. All test data prefixed 'TEST_'. No persisted data left between runs (page.reload only, no write to disk).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25 confirmed: (1) PDF split-of-undefined crash fixed by projects/[id].tsx:1619-1629. (2) useUnsavedChangesGuard hook works correctly on customers/new, customers/[id] (window.confirm fires, accept saves, dismiss stays). (3) The projects/[id] Notes tab guard only fires when the user actually leaves the route (outer Zurück / native swipe). Tapping the internal 'Projektdetails' tab-switch back arrow does NOT trigger the guard because that handler calls handleTabChange('overview') instead of router.back(). Unsaved remarks ARE preserved through the tab switch and saved when the user then taps outer Zurück, so no data loss. Reports/edit was not tested (behind Pro-mode gate; hook usage identical, low risk).
rca_of_issue: The 'PDF split of undefined' bug happened because the empty-checklist branch previously returned a plain string, but downstream code at line 1718 did `item.categoriesHtml.split('<!--CATEGORY_SPLIT-->')` expecting an object with a categoriesHtml string field. The applied fix returns the same object shape (categoriesHtml, totalChecked, totalItems, templateLogoHtml) as the non-empty branch, so .split() is now always defined. Verified by seeding a checklist with all items unchecked and simultaneously seeding a sketch (which triggers the auto-regenerate useEffect at line 467): no error is thrown and no 'Error auto-regenerating PDF' message is logged.
